propositions: The close precheck scans all reachable commit messages and calls resolve_ticket_id for every extracted reference, which prints ambiguity diagnostics to stderr even for unrelated historical ticket references.
Ambiguous short prefixes in historical commits trigger 'Ambiguous prefix matches multiple tickets' errors that are unrelated to the actual close operation and do not affect gate semantics.
resolve_ticket_id prints diagnostics directly to stderr via three conditional branches but returns consistent values regardless, making the output pure noise in history-scan contexts.

A quiet parameter added to resolve_ticket_id gates the three stderr ambiguity prints, passed as quiet=True only from the history-scan loop while preserving full diagnostics for explicit user-supplied ambiguous IDs.
Valid full-ID commit references are still correctly detected by the precheck even when earlier history contains ambiguous short prefixes.
